usable_fraction.note: share of a Li-ion pack's rated energy used before the BMS cut-off; measure on the bench

converter_efficiency.note: buck converter efficiency at about 1-2 A; measure on the bench

mcu_power_w.note: ESP32-class microcontroller average with Wi-Fi idle; measure on the bench

chassis_mass_kg.note: printed chassis, board, fasteners, caster and wiring; weigh it
